    <h2><a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/jyzhao/p/19508942/apex-shi-zhan-di10pian-shou-ba-shou-jiao-ni-geiape" title="发布于 2026-01-20 22:15">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">APEX实战第10篇：手把手教你给APEX打补丁</span>
    

</a>
</h2>
    <small>
<span id="post-date" data-last-update-days="0" data-date-updated="2026-01-20 22:15">2026-01-20 22:15</span>&nbsp;
<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/jyzhao">AlfredZhao</a>&nbsp;
阅读(<span id="post_view_count">69</span>)&nbsp;
评论(<span id="post_comment_count">0</span>)&nbsp;
&nbsp;
<a href="javascript:void(0)" onclick="AddToWz(19508942);return false;">收藏</a>&nbsp;
<a href="javascript:void(0)" onclick="reportManager.report({ currentUserId: '', targetType: 'blogPost', targetId: '19508942', targetLink: 'https://www.cnblogs.com/jyzhao/p/19508942/apex-shi-zhan-di10pian-shou-ba-shou-jiao-ni-geiape', title: 'APEX实战第10篇：手把手教你给APEX打补丁' })">举报</a>
</small>
    <div class="entry">
        <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>这一期技术上没什么难度，但却很重要，因为任何企业级软件，定期应用补丁是很必要的，可以有效规避很多已知bug。</p>
<p>下面我们就以 <code>APEX 24.2</code> 版本为例，使用MOS可以直接搜到最新的补丁集信息，这是一个月前才发布的bundle包，其中已经包含了目前最新的 <code>24.2.12</code> 补丁集：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/635610/202601/635610-20260120221500169-644256984.jpg" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>点击 <code>Download</code>，下载，只有2.6M大小。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/635610/202601/635610-20260120221500138-290754377.jpg" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>然后严格按照README说明进行操作即可。这里按照笔者的Linux环境，实际执行步骤如下：</p>
<h2 id="1下载的补丁介质上传到apex环境的任意目录下">1.下载的补丁介质上传到APEX环境的任意目录下</h2>
<ul>
<li>p37366599_242_GENERIC.zip</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="2解压补丁介质">2.解压补丁介质</h2>
<ul>
<li>unzip p37366599_242_GENERIC.zip</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="3关闭ords服务">3.关闭ORDS服务</h2>
<p>安装时要求关闭ORDS以阻止对ORDS和APEX的访问：</p>
<blockquote>
<ol start="3">
<li>
<p>Preventing Access to Oracle REST Data Services</p>
<p>It is important that no developers or end users access Oracle APEX while you are applying the patch. This section describes how to prevent access to Oracle APEX.</p>
<p>Stopping Oracle REST Data Services:</p>
<p>To learn more about stopping the Oracle REST Data Services server, see Oracle REST Data Services Installation and Configuration Guide:</p>
<p><a href="https://docs.oracle.com/en/database/oracle/oracle-rest-data-services/index.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://docs.oracle.com/en/database/oracle/oracle-rest-data-services/index.html</a></p>
</li>
</ol>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="4切换到37366599目录下">4.切换到37366599目录下</h2>
<ul>
<li>cd 37366599</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="5设置nls_lang环境变量">5.设置NLS_LANG环境变量</h2>
<ul>
<li>NLS_LANG=American_America.AL32UTF8</li>
<li>export NLS_LANG</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="6sys用户执行脚本">6.sys用户执行脚本</h2>
<p>官方安装说明详细的给出了几种不同情况，对应笔者实际情况，只是在某一个PDB下安装了APEX，<br>
因此这里只在安装了APEX的PDB下执行这个脚本即可：</p>
<ul>
<li>@catpatch.sql</li>
</ul>
<p>执行完成，确认没有报错，再查询下APEX组件状态OK：</p>
<pre><code class="language-SQL">SELECT comp_id, comp_name, version, status 
FROM dba_registry 
WHERE comp_id = 'APEX';
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/635610/202601/635610-20260120221500130-878148293.jpg" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="7-针对images目录的更新">7. 针对images目录的更新</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>Install the Patch Set Exception's changes in the images directory</p>
<p>cp -rf /tmp/images ORACLE_APEX_HOME/apex</p>
</blockquote>
<p>笔者注：特别需要注意下这个拷贝，最好先使用命令 <code>ords config list</code> 查询确认下，自己的配置是否相同，比如笔者这里路径就不是默认的images：</p>
<blockquote>
<p>standalone.static.path                   /u02/app/apex/apex_images              Global</p>
</blockquote>
<p>这是因为笔者之前安装是把原本的images复制了一份apex_images，所以这里应该把新的images下面的文件拷贝到apex_images这个目录下才对，如果你没有这样的情况，就直接复制命令即可。</p>
<h2 id="8启动ords登录apex验证">8.启动ORDS，登录APEX验证</h2>
<p>一切正常，APEX主页这里 <code>Available Updates</code> 显示系统已是最新状态：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/635610/202601/635610-20260120221500019-1301140551.jpg" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>APEX界面的右下角还可以看到具体版本号，就是我们本次安装的 <code>Oracle APEX 24.2.12</code>：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/635610/202601/635610-20260120221459988-1096283148.jpg" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>至此，已完成给APEX打补丁的全部工作。</p>
